blocks.label: LC424 Longest Repeating Character Replacement
blocks.py:
cnt = defaultdict(int); maxf = l = best = 0
for r, c in enumerate(s):
    cnt[c] += 1
    maxf = max(maxf, cnt[c])
    if r - l + 1 - maxf > k:             # budget exceeded
        cnt[s[l]] -= 1; l += 1           # LAZY single-step shrink
    best = max(best, r - l + 1)

from collections import defaultdict
best = {}                                # suffix_sum -> fewest right picks
run = 0
for j in range(n-1, -1, -1):
    run += a[j]
    best.setdefault(run, n-j)
pre, ans = 0, float('inf')
for i in range(n+1):
    if x - pre in best:
        ans = min(ans, i + best[x-pre])
    if i < n: pre += a[i]
